title: A gate asserts CSP, HSTS and Permissions-Policy are present
detail:
check-headers is not a header gate and no script asserts security headers. Tiny gate over next.config.ts headers().

scripts/check-security-headers.mjs asserts the five baseline headers, the HSTS floor, the CSP directives that must stay and a default Permissions-Policy; it runs in the CI contract guards.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
